verdict.rationale: Tavily Crawl explicitly traverses a website's content starting from a base URL with graph-based parallel exploration and intelligent discovery, and Map generates full site maps similarly, both documented with SDK examples (tavily_client.crawl(...), tavily_client.map(...)). This directly satisfies crawling subpages/entire sites from a starting URL. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs and GitHub README, and no explicit example of crawling starting directly from a search result URL (only from an arbitrary base URL).
